notes: All four UI panels (Agents/Skills/MCP/Trails) now render real repository data instead of being inert buttons - verified by directly curling the new endpoint against the live repo and inspecting the JSON, not merely by inspecting the code. The lint failure caught mid-cycle (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) was a genuine bug the build tooling found, not a style nit - fixed by moving data-loading into the click handler rather than an effect, which is also the more correct React pattern for 'fetch in response to a user action'. MCP panel deliberately stays honest about not providing live tool/resource/prompt discovery (that's increment 3), matching this seed's own constraint. No filesystem mutation endpoints were added - GetIndex only reads.
